title: The finite tensor of inverse reduction evaluations
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W in universe u, and n≥0. Let r be the specified ordinary coherent reduction, e_n the sequence evaluation, T_n the specified total tensor over the finite coefficient ring, and s_n restriction to the completed coefficient ring. The normalized reduction evaluations identify ordinary finite scalar extension with r followed by e_n. Tensor their inverses and apply s_n to construct a natural isomorphism ((r^c × r^c);(e_n^c × e_n^c));T_n;s_n^c ≅ integralOperationsTensorLevel(l,E,W,n), on pairs of arbitrary unbounded completed-module cochain complexes. This is the actual threefold whiskering of the product of those inverse natural isomorphisms, with no choice of arbitrary witnesses, no boundedness hypothesis, and no claim about transitions between different n.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 0941, the ringed sequence site

proof.text: Take the product of two copies of the inverse unit-normalized reduction-evaluation natural isomorphism on complexes. Whisker by the finite total tensor bifunctor, then by finite scalar restriction. Its target is definitionally the actual integralOperationsTensorLevel functor, and its components are exactly the finite tensor of the two inverse reduction evaluations.

def pullbackTensorFiniteReductionComparison (W : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    ((((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
      ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
      (((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)))) ⋙
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (ProEt.topology W)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n) ⋙
      (scalarReductionRestriction l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
      integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n
